subject: Life Skills
title: When Mediation Helps
description: A fast breakdown of When Mediation Helps for builders.

hook.text: Mediated disputes settle about 85% of the time. Court cases settle under 5% before trial.

buildup.text: A mediator is a neutral third party who facilitates conversation without taking sides or making decisions.

discovery.text: Mediation works because a neutral presence reduces emotional flooding and keeps the discussion structured.

twist.text: Mediation is voluntary. Both parties must agree to participate, and either can leave at any time.

climax.text: If direct conversation has failed multiple times, suggest mediation as a next step, not a last resort.

punchline.text: A neutral voice helps both sides finally hear.

quiz.question: Why is mediation more effective than going to court?
options: The mediator makes the final decision
A neutral facilitator reduces emotional flooding
Mediation is legally binding and faster
